status: accepted fixed-parameter native parity and marked comparator; parent executed both adapters
conditioning: ordinary first-capture-conditional CJS; first-capture emission and earlier history omitted

permuted: same literal individuals and coefficients with history and predictor rows permuted to test keyed alignment
marked_constant: matched external comparator subset; fully observed, equal intervals, intercept-only survival and detection

formulas.phi: logit unit-time apparent survival = intercept + x + habitat_B + offset
formulas.p: logit detection conditional alive = intercept + x + method_B + offset

factor_levels.coding: treatment/dummy coding with A as reference

oracle: The frozen log likelihood was computed by explicit enumeration of every alive/dead state path from each first capture through administrative end. The R adapter independently recomputes this oracle from the literal design tables; native objectives are evaluated separately.
fit_parity: Native objectives evaluated at literal coefficients and marked MLE. Native optimizer equivalence and parameter recovery are not claimed.
license_boundary: Only generated numerical outputs from marked are retained. No marked implementation source is copied into either package.
